                                                            FADE IN:

     1   EXT. BUS STOP - NIGHT                                       1

         Rain hammers the tin roof. A single streetlight flickers
         above an empty road.

                                 MEERA
                       (stepping into the light)
                   You said you would never come back.
                   Not after what happened.

                                 ARJUN
                   I said a lot of things.

                                                            CUT TO:

     2   INT. APARTMENT - MORNING                                    2

         Sunlight. The kettle whistles.
